scope: All eight actual public captures opened individually. Four functional checks pass, but two native UI defects need correction before visual approval.

images.label: two-natural-gauges
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: Three allies and two geth are separated. Ready gauges and the reserved Kaidan gauge are visible. The transient reservation toast overlaps part of the upper-right toolbar until it disappears.

images.label: two-order-draft-desktop
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: Two participants are named and the execute/cancel controls are readable. The remove controls are white squares without a visibly contrasting × glyph.

images.label: two-order-draft-mobile
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: At 390 pixels the draft, named participants and execute/cancel controls fit without horizontal overflow; target controls remain reachable below. The remove glyphs have the same low-contrast defect. The open command panel covers much of the battlefield while preparing orders.

images.label: two-orders-executed
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: Both participants show Chaleur 24 % and spent ATB gauges; the action log records two real shots and their shield damage.

images.label: range-after-real-withdrawal
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: Shepard is visibly farther from the geth. Both targets are disabled with 11.2/8.5 and 11.6/8.5 range feedback, consistent with the equipped starter shotgun.

images.label: real-advance
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: The actor returns toward the group through a real native move. With a self-target action selected, target distance incorrectly reads 0.0 / undefined u.; this needs a finite-range UI guard.

images.label: actual-victory
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: The real victory panel reports two opponents, 14 total actions, +65 XP and +85 credits; no forced victory or added enemy body is depicted.

images.label: actual-save-reload
images.source: Actual public viewport, no DOM/style/pose injection.
images.method: tools.view_image at original screenshot resolution; individually opened
observations: The real reload returns to exploration with Ashley replacing the narrative loss of Jenkins. The party remains visible and progression matches the actual exported save.

blockingFindings.observation: The native remove buttons render with white background and no visible × contrast.
blockingFindings.requestedCorrection: Scope background/text/border styles to .coordinated-orders button; keep accessible label.

blockingFindings.observation: Self-target movement selection shows 0.0 / undefined u. on enemy targets.
blockingFindings.requestedCorrection: Render a numeric distance/range only when both values are finite; self-target actions do not have an enemy range.

nonBlockingFindings: The temporary reservation toast can overlap the toolbar until it disappears.
At 390 pixels the expanded draft covers much of the world while keeping its public controls reachable.
limitations: The initial briefing/visit and position at the first Eden encounter are prepared in Node, not played as a traversal.
Only one story-difficulty early campaign battle is played here; 468 paired native comparisons cover the other formations separately.
Scene-unit ranges and local motion are ATB adaptations, not original ballistic/physics rules or a likeness certification.
No physical gamepad or Windows executable is launched by this public browser collector.
